Desc_217.en: As the saying goes, "The heart is the king of the body. If you want to save a person, you must first save the heart." The Heart Care Pill can directly reach the heart meridian, and has the effect of nourishing the heart and Qi.
Desc_217.cn: 正所谓：“心者，君之位也”，心脉不通，气滞难行；若欲救人，必先救心。元灵护心丸药力可直达心脉，有养心正气之效。

Desc_218.en: I wash my cup the morning and pour the liquor; it has congealed into the autumn dew. Aucklandia Liquor is made by dipping Aucklandia Root in liquor. Its taste is not the pungency of liquor, but has the sweetness of herb, and can be taken to remove the turbidity and replenish the clarity.
Desc_218.cn: “朝来洗盏酹先酒，凝若金茎秋露珠”，黄龙琼露乃以木香为引，浸于酒中方成；其味无酒之辛，而有药之甜，服之可以去浊补清。

Desc_219.en: The Heavenly Aroma Pill has a dazzling white color and an intoxicating aroma, which can make the Qi harmonious and smooth, like the medicine used by the gods.
Desc_219.cn: 此丹白若有光，香可醉人，服之能使气和以顺，各从所欲，便如仙神所用之药，取李太白“水白虎溪月，天香生虚空”诗意，名曰“天香太一丹”。

Desc_220.en: This medicine has an ink-like color and overbearing medicinal properties, after consumption, it is as if the body is on fire, can nourish the Primordial Qi. No matter what medicines are consumed together, the effect of this medicine must take effect first and cannot be questioned, hence the name 'Emperor Powder.'
Desc_220.cn: 此药色如乌金，药性霸道，服后如有炎阳入于丹田，滋生元气，不论与何种药共用，此散药力必后发先至，不容置喙，故名“益元帝膏散”。

Desc_221.en: Luminous Pill has a strong aroma, glows at night, its taste is pungent and sweet, and its color is like white snow. After consumption, it can make the hearing and vision sensitive, nourish the spirit, and stabilize the Primordial Qi.
Desc_221.cn: 宝光香丸香远而益清，上有青光，夜中尤明，其味辛而回甘，其色皑皑如雪，服之可以新耳目，养精神，使元气安稳，动静皆宜。

Desc_222.en: Made of tranquilizing herbs, with a jade-like texture, and can be taken with water, and can also be burned as incense. It can calm the mind and relieve the depression of Qi.
Desc_222.cn: 此丸以安魂药材制成，质地如玉，可以水冲服，亦可燃作熏香，用后可定神解乏，纾内力郁阻，正是：“玉烛调元黍律均，迎长嘉节属芳辰”。

Desc_223.en: When placed in a dark place, the Luminous Drink emits fluorescence like shining stars, and after taking it, it fills one's body with Qi and enables one to endure severe cold and heat.
Desc_223.cn: 夜光玉露置于暗处时，便有荧光点点，如腐草之精，又如星曜闪烁，服之便如有冰肌玉骨化生，使人气海充盈，不畏寒暑。

Desc_224.en: The Astral Paste is made from the legendary Azuris Orchid that can attract the astral spiritual Qi, and after the medicine is made, the overflowing aroma can last for many days.
Desc_224.cn: 七星护元膏以传说中的瑶池仙草制成，可引七星之灵气为御，成药香遍四野，清幽可爱，有如余音绕梁，三日而不绝。

Desc_225.en: As the saying goes, "Qi is the mother of mind, and mind is the son of Qi. If you have them both, you can be immortal." Azuris Elixir has a flowing light of silver and a sweet taste. It is said that it is made of orchid grass grown in the immortal's blessed land, which can nourish the mind and benefit the Qi and awaken the soul, and some people say that drinking it regularly can lead to immortality.
Desc_225.cn: 所谓：“气为神母，神为气子。神气若俱，长生不死”。瑶池仙饮流光如银，入口甘甜，传闻乃仙家福地所生兰草所制，服之可补神益气，苏醒人魂，或云多食可以长生。

Desc_226.en: This powder can correct the deficiency of Qi and keep the evil Qi out of the body like a shield blocking the wind, and because it is as beautiful as jade, it is named "Jade Shield Powder."
Desc_226.cn: 此药“可正气补虚，固卫去邪，风邪既去而不能复入矣，此所以依如屏而珍如玉也”，故而得名“玉屏风散”。

Desc_227.en: Wondrous Herb Pill is made of wondrous herbs and has a white jade-like color. After taking it, it can help the Qi return to the Dantian and calm the mind.
Desc_227.cn: 此丹以灵草为引，色如白碧，服后可助人气归丹田，以静制动，故名“灵草沉气丹”。

Desc_228.en: Jade Herb Tea is a bitter tea brewed with herbs, using the tea to protect the medicinal effect, its color is transparent like jade, drinking it can cure wind-cold and relieve fatigue.
Desc_228.cn: 秀玉珍茗以药入茗，以茶护药，其味不甘而苦，其色通透如玉，饮之可治风寒束表，解乏生力。

Desc_229.en: This powder is white and tasteless, it will make people have a floating feeling, easily dissolve the brute force, as easily as scattering the floating clouds, so it is called 'Clouds Powder.'
Desc_229.cn: 此药色白而无味，服之有飘然之感，可令气随神动，将来力化于无形，便如浮云散聚般轻巧，故谓之曰“施云散”。

Desc_230.en: Azurelight Drink is as clear as spring water, its taste is slightly astringent, and after drinking it, it makes you feel as if you are bathed in the spring sunshine, making your Qi grow and originate.
Desc_230.cn: 春为青阳，以其“气青而温阳”也，青阳仙露清如山泉，其味微涩，服后若有青阳之光遍照周身，使气力生发，源源不绝。

Desc_231.en: Loong Spittle Drink Emits a colorful light, but only those with wisdom can see it. Its taste is both bitter and sweet, and it can dispel Qi knots and relieve fatigue, making people feel as if they have gained the power of a loong and can soar in the sky.
Desc_231.cn: 百宝龙涎露有百宝之光，但唯有身具慧根之人可见，其味亦苦亦甘，服之消气结，解疲劳，如得龙气，可翔于高天。

Desc_232.en: The Focus Pill has a fragrant smell and can be taken to circulate Qi and blood and to gather the essence of the mind. Some people believe that it can make people never forget, so they will use it when studying and reading.
Desc_232.cn: 百合聚神丹气味芬芳，其药力自下焦始，渐入三焦，服之可流通气血，聚神集精，或以为有使人过目不忘之功，于温书时亦用之。

Desc_233.en: Trio refers to essence, Qi and spirit. This incense can unite these three, and dissipate the external forces like driving mist.
Desc_233.cn: 三花即三华，精、气、神是也，分主炼精化气，炼气化神，炼神还虚。此香可凝聚精神，将外来之力如驱雾般化散。

Desc_234.en: The Soaring Roc Pill is made of spirit materials, and cloud-like light flows over it. It is fragrant and sweet, and can be taken to make Qi flourish and grow, as powerful as a roc soaring in the clouds.
Desc_234.cn: 万里蔽云丹以灵材制成，其上光华流转，如有云飘雾动，气香而味甘，服之可令精力蓬勃而生，威如鹏鸟展翅，云翳万里。

Desc_235.en: As the ancients said, "The Soul is Yang Qi." Calm Soul Pill is as transparent as colored glaze, and can be taken to calm the soul and replenish Yang.
Desc_235.cn: 古人云：“魂，阳气也”。定魂琉璃丹质如琉璃，内外明彻，服之可以安魂补阳，使营卫相调，卫外固密。

Desc_236.en: The relief is to let go. Taking Great Relief Powder can make people resist the force of ten thousand kilos, but must use strong tonic medicine to clear the mind and strengthen the body, so that they do not hurt themselves, then they can reach the realm of free relief.
Desc_236.cn: 释者，放也。大释散服后能卸万钧之力，但必以大补之药明心健体，使己身不为劲风所伤，方可达至收放自如，不图蛮勇的境界。

Desc_237.en: The color of the Nine-color Drink changes from time to time, like seeing all the colors in the world, and its flavor is also indistinct. It opens one's spiritual awareness and makes one understand how to defeat what can be defeated and evade what cannot be defeated.
Desc_237.cn: 九乃极数，言色之多也，九色菩提露光华因时而易，如见世间万色，其味似有若无，服之可开启灵觉，识可破与不可破，可破则御之，不可破则避之。

Desc_238.en: This pill is made of tonic herb, has a yellow color and a mild sweet taste, and can stabilize the mind after taking it.
Desc_238.cn: 此丹以滋补药物制成，色如田黄，故名“萃黄丹”，其味甘平，服后可使心神安定，不为五色所扰。

Desc_239.en: The Cold Spring Pill has a cool taste and a sea-like blue color. After taking it, it seems like a cold spring gushing out from the heart and going around the body, which can make the ears and eyes clear.
Desc_239.cn: 滋心丹味凉而清，色碧如水，服后如有寒泉自心脉涌出，绕行周身，可使耳聪目明，视物不乱。

Desc_240.en: Perception Pill "When you see the willow, you will see the wind; when you see the cloud, you will see the sun behind it." Uses the essence of spiritual materials to guide the innate Qi, enabling people to understand the nature of things and the principles of heaven and earth.
Desc_240.cn: 拨云宝丸以灵材之精导先天之气，服之可通物性，感天地之理，所谓“看柳知风，拨云见日”,皆不在话下。

Desc_241.en: The insightful attack enemies' weak points while avoiding their strong points and defeat them with insight and ingenuity. Insight Gold Pills shine with a golden color and have the effect of removing turbidity and clearing the ears and eyes, which can be taken to identify the reality.
Desc_241.cn: 寸巧者，言避实就虚，以巧胜力也。寸巧寸金丹色如黄金，有除浊气，清耳目之效，服之可辨虚实。

Desc_242.en: The Crimson White Pill is pure white with a red pattern on it, hence the name 'Crimson White Pill.' It harmonizes the Qi and blood and makes all parts of the body harmonious and flexible.
Desc_242.cn: 赤白丹丹体纯白，上有赤色花纹，故名“赤白丹”，服之可使气血协调，肢体各处无不如臂使指。

Desc_243.en: The Amber Pill is like a piece of red amber with the fragrance of cardamom. It can make up for deficiencies and relieve congestion, so that the Qi is smooth and the body is light, and the action is as desired.
Desc_243.cn: 琥珀如意丹色如赤色琥珀，有豆蔻之香，服之可补亏损、解壅滞，使气顺体轻，行止如意。

Desc_244.en: Everything requires concentration to succeed. The Concentration Incense is refined with several materials of concentration, which can help one to stay focused at critical moments to find a chance of survival.
Desc_244.cn: 凡事轻举无功，三思而行，方可万全。万全香以数种凝神之物精炼而成，可助人在心念电闪之间寻得一线生机。

Desc_245.en: The Sha silk forms square holes, whereas the Luo does not. Fragrant silk is a dense fabric made of silk threads, and Fragrant Silk Powder provides insight into the truth of things as if one could see through the dense fragrant silk.
Desc_245.cn: “方孔曰纱，椒孔曰罗”。罗乃绞经织成，牵一发则动全身，香罗散却入上焦诸经，服之可令人看穿网罗，提纲挈领。

Desc_246.en: As the saying goes, "A clear pond may reflect the spring, as the ancient mirror may reflect the gods." The Mirror Pill is almost transparent, which can make a person's eyes sharp and find a needle in the haystack with just one glance; it can also make one's heart as clear as a mirror, he will not tremble even if a mountain collapses in front of him.
Desc_246.cn: 所谓：“空潭泻春，古镜照神”，明镜丹形貌特异，通透如可视物，服后可使人目光如炬，风吹草动皆入眼中；心明似镜，泰山崩于前而不改色。

Desc_247.en: A true wise man was born no different, but knows how to make use of tools. The Eight Immortals are said to be the eight sages who attained immortality with their mortal bodies. The Eight Immortals Pill is shaped like a lotus flower, which can make one's mind as clear as the Eight Immortals.
Desc_247.cn: “君子性非异也，善假于物也”，八仙相传乃八位以凡身登仙的先贤，素擅神通。八仙妙华丹形如莲华，服后可使心神清明，妙法不绝，如得八仙遗风。

Desc_248.en: When the Loong rises from the bottom of the sea, it provokes a gale that the world has never seen. The Loong on Sea Pill has a dark blue color like the deep sea with a loong-like golden pattern on it. The medicinal effect can make a person like a flying loong in the sky, with an unobstructed view of the mortal world.
Desc_248.cn: “苍龙卧海未称雄，起身惊动九重风”。苍龙卧海丹丹色绀碧，如万里深海；上有金纹，如龙卧其上；服后药力生发，如飞龙在天，可将凡尘俗世一览无余。

Desc_249.en: The ultimate pureness offers insight into the universe. The Insight Powder is an extremely rare medicine that can make one gain insight into everything and understand the wonders of all rules.
Desc_249.cn: 诗云：“净而纯中无一尘，纯而净中有万应”。万应玲珑散乃世间奇药，服之可使人灵台清明，觉花开叶落，察秋毫始生，悟万法之妙，随机而应变。

Desc_250.en: This medicine is made of spiritstone, shiny like silver, so it is named 'Silver Powder.' Its taste is slightly bitter, but it can stimulate the potential and make people agile.
Desc_250.cn: 此药以灵石制成，光泽如银，故称“银光散”，其味微苦，服后可激发潜力，使人身手敏捷。

Desc_251.en: The Mist Pill is made of a kind of strange stone that emits silver light, which can make people feel as light as mist, moving at will and with ease.
Desc_251.cn: 飞雾丹以奇石制成，上有银光，服后只觉身轻如雾，随意而动，如以有间入无间，游刃有余。

Desc_252.en: The Iridescent Elixir is as sweet as spring water and enables people to move easily and make movements that dazzle the eyes like "clouds with radiant colors."
Desc_252.cn: 五光饮甘如山泉，服后使人行动便捷，动如“彩云出崖，五光徘徊，十色陆离”，使人眼花缭乱。

Desc_253.en: The Mirror Flower Drink is as colorless and odorless as dew, and can make people swift and elusive, as visible and inaccessible as the flower in the mirror and the moon in the water.
Desc_253.cn: 镜中花露无色无味，宛如朝露，服后可令人身手迅捷，行动难以捉摸，如镜花无形，水月无影。

Desc_254.en: The Azure Frost Pill is made of elixir condensed with blue frost and water, and is best made in autumn to make people as swift as wind and lightning.
Desc_254.cn: 青霜碧水丹乃是取灵药与青霜、碧水凝结而成，其色如韭，以秋日所制为最佳，服后可如青霜掠影，紫电惊风。

Desc_255.en: The Cicada Dew Drink is made of late autumn dew and early winter cicada. Its color is changeable, its taste is sweet and fleeting. It can make people move like the wind that can only be heard but not seen.
Desc_255.cn: 万幻蝉露以晚秋之露、初冬之蝉制成，其色变幻不定，其味甘而转瞬即逝，服后使人如乘风而去，只闻其声，不见其影。

Desc_256.en: The Hibiscus Drink is made from drunken hibiscus. After drinking it, you will feel tired at first and breathe with the fragrance of flowers, but after this fragrance dissipates, your ears and eyes will be clear and refreshed.
Desc_256.cn: 玉蓉清神露以醉芙蓉为引，服后先有一股倦意升腾，呼吸间俱是花香，此香散去后则耳聪目明，清新如洗。

Desc_257.en: As the saying goes, "It's not the liquor that intoxicates but the drinker who gets himself drunk." Lotus Elixir has the fragrance of lotus flowers. Those who drink it with depression will fall down after just one drop; those who drink it with happiness will remain sober after a thousand gulps.
Desc_257.cn: 俗语云：“酒不醉人人自醉”，莲华醉清气如莲，心中郁结之人饮之，一滴便倒；胸怀畅快之人饮之，万盅犹醒。

Desc_258.en: Hundreds kinds of flowers are used to make Floral Powder, so it is extremely rare and luxurious. After taking it, you will feel light and airy.
Desc_258.cn: 百花逍遥散取百种珍奇药草制成，尤以鲜花为佳，极为奢侈，服后便感其身飘然，不知所止，如“至神逍遥倏忽，而不见其容”云。

Desc_259.en: This pill is colorless and tasteless, and after seeing it, an eminent monk said it conforms to the saying "Form is emptiness." After taking it, one is not clouded by appearances and forms. Even if one loses all five senses, one can still see the truth.
Desc_259.cn: 此丹无色无味，曾有高僧见之，赞曰合“色即是空，空即是色”之理，故而得名；服后可不受外相所扰，即便五感皆失，亦可察觉先机。

Desc_260.en: The nine spirits include loong, fenghuang, tiger, rhino, silkworm, luan bird, deer, Jiao loong, and ape. This tea originally required nine spirits to brew, the lack of any one of them will cause a reduction in the medicinal properties. After the tea is steeped, nine colors intertliquord on it, it is rumored that only the Lord of the Heavens can drink it. Human power is limited, so even if only one or two of the spirits are used, it still has a miraculous effect.
Desc_260.cn: 九灵者：龙、凤、虎、兕、蚕、鸾、鹿、蛟、猿也，此药原需以九灵为引，少一灵则药力减一分，成药有九色交织，传闻只有天帝可以享用。人力有穷，故只取其中一二味，亦有奇效。

Desc_261.en: Golden Silkworm Mulse Made of precious spiritual materials, it is medicine but has the world's best taste and is extremely rare. It can make people change themselves like silkworms breaking out of their chrysalis.
Desc_261.cn: 金蚕蜜饮以珍贵灵材制成，虽是药而有世间至味，极为罕见，服后如蚕生双翅，移形换影，脱胎易骨，其中诸般感受，难以为外人道。

Desc_262.en: Insect Saliva powder is made from the saliva of spirit insects, with a slight fishy smell and a bitter-sweet taste. It can relieve cough and heat, regulate and harmonize Qi, and is often used by families with young children.
Desc_262.cn: 虫涎散以灵虫涎水为引制成，其味略腥，苦而回甘，服之可止咳消热，理气调中，家有幼童者常备之。

Desc_263.en: Snake is commonly known as small loong, and this pill is made from five kinds of spirit snakes, so it is called 'Small Loong Pill.' It can dispel cold and evil and nourish the Qi.
Desc_263.cn: 蛇行蜿蜒，俗谓小龙，此丹需以五种灵蛇入药，故名“小龙内壮丹”，服之可以祛除风邪，补养正气。

Desc_264.en: This pill is made from various groundlings such as insects and snakes, hence the name Groundling Pill. It has an earthy yellow color and fishy bitter taste, yet it has the effect of unblocking the meridians.
Desc_264.cn: 此丹以各味地行虫蛇等为引，故名地皇丹。其色土黄，味腥而苦，却有疏通经络之效。

Desc_265.en: The Spirit Blood Pill is made from the blood of spiritual creatures, emitting a luster of green, gold and red, its taste is bland and can be taken to clear congestion in the meridians.
Desc_265.cn: 宝血玄丹以灵物之血为引，上有青、金、赤三色华光，其色玄，其味平，性入三焦，服之可通经脉壅滞。

Desc_266.en: The Archaeus Pill, unifying all the three aspects of the world, has a strange medicinal power: it will first condense the Archaeus around you, and after getting rid of the impurities in it, then release the Archaeus out, which can help the True Qi to run in the exhalation.
Desc_266.cn: “三统合为一元，故因元一而九三之以为法”，元一丹药力奇异，服后先聚周身之气为一元，祛除杂气后，方又散回，能于吐纳之中助真气运行。

Desc_267.en: Although the Bashe Gall Pill is made of the titan Bashe's bile, but there is no fishy smell of bile at all, and it faintly emits a holy light, rare and unusual, it can be taken to heal the heart and abdominal diseases.
Desc_267.cn: 巴蟒玄胆丸虽以巴蛇之胆制成，却无一丝胆汁腥气，其上隐有宝光，罕见异常，服之可愈心腹之疾，使气足神完。

Desc_268.en: The main ingredient of Musk Panacea Paste is musk. It is brown in color, fragrant, soft and delicious. It is rumored to have been taken by people who had ruptured their meridians and were immediately healed.
Desc_268.cn: 麝香回春膏以麝香为主料，其色或棕或褐，香气四溢，软滑可口，传闻曾有经脉坼裂之人服之，如枯木逢春，登时痊愈。

Desc_269.en: The Abhiseka Incense is made from the condensation of the medicine for breath regulation. It is milky white in color and smells like orchid, it can improve the vitality of the body and wash away the impurities like the abhiseka.
Desc_269.cn: 灌顶香以调息之药并醍醐制成，其色乳白，气如兰芷，嗅之可调中益气，如灌顶之时得净瓶甘露，洗去浊垢。

Desc_270.en: The Qi consists of the clear and the turbid The Harmony Dew is made from herbs that nourish the Qi, and can be taken to harmonize the Yin and the Yang.
Desc_270.cn: 所谓“营卫者，精气也”，营血为阴，卫气为阳，营卫不和，则气血不畅。调营保神露以养气药草制成，服之可使营卫调和，阴阳相安。

Desc_271.en: The Golden Nectar, with a flowing and elusive texture like gold, can make people's Qi and blood flow smoothly. As the saying goes, "One sip of the Golden Nectar may make one immortal."
Desc_271.cn: 金露琼饮服后可令气血从顺，精神内守，其质如流金，捉摸不定，不似人间物，故有诗云：“偷将缺吻吸琼浆，蜕尽骨毛作仙子”。

Desc_272.en: It is difficult to regulate the innate weakness of the body and internal deficiency. This medicine can be used to replenish the innate spirit and calm the chaos of all the Qi, hence the name "Innate Powder."
Desc_272.cn: 先天者，生身以前，天地、父母所赋也；先天不足，则体弱内虚，难以调理。此药可以天材地宝补先天灵根，平诸气之乱，故名“先天散”。

Desc_273.en: Golden Peach Drink contains the essence of immortal fruit, flowing like a rainbow, its taste is sweet and timeless, it can nourish the Qi and suppress evil, dredging the Eight Extraordinary Meridians.
Desc_273.cn: 金母者，西王母也，西方属金，故又名“金母”。金母蟠桃露蕴仙果之精，流光如虹，其味甘而隽永，经年难忘，服之可养气镇邪，疏通奇经八脉。

Desc_274.en: This decoction can be taken to nourish the blood and vitalize the Qi, so that the vigorous force is self-generated, hence the name.
Desc_274.cn: 所谓：“呼吸之动，因血气之发。血气之发，附于骨肉”。此汤服之可养血活气，使劲力自生，故而得名。

Desc_275.en: The Anosia Paste has a brownish-yellow color and a slightly pungent taste, and when taken with strong liquor, it can make the muscles and bones strong.
Desc_275.cn: 骨者皮肉之所附，衰则体弱，健则体强，壮骨膏颜色棕黄，其味微辛，服之若饮烈酒，可令筋骨强健。

Desc_276.en: The Ironbone Pill is made of blood revitalizing medicine and honey, it can make the tendons and bones as hard as hundred-forged steel, and it is as if you are wielding two pairs of steel fists when fighting.
Desc_276.cn: 大力百锻丹以活血生筋之药合蜜炼成，服之便可使筋骨如百锻精钢，举手投足皆有金铁之重、破风之声。

Desc_277.en: The Powerhouse Pill has a bitter taste and brown color, and can make people burst out unstoppable divine power, a power that can only be coped with by the skillful strength of an accomplished external practitioner.
Desc_277.cn: 千斤丸味苦色褐，服后可使人迸发千斤之力，势不可挡，若非功力深厚的外家，便只能以巧劲应对，否则恐有灭顶之虞。

Desc_278.en: The Lionlike Powder is a dry black-red powder made of herbs that nourish the blood and muscle, it can make a person's energy increase greatly, as if he can make the lionlike roar.
Desc_278.cn: 神功壮力散以生肌养血之药材制成，药色黑红，为干粉状，服后气力大增，形于声色，好似习得神功狮子吼。

Desc_279.en: Rumor has it that King Lingzhi only grows in the fairyland and is the most exotic herb that can save the life of a dead person. Made from this plant, King Lingzhi Powder has the effect of removing all diseases and improving vitality.
Desc_279.cn: 传闻芝王生于洞天福地之中，乃至奇之仙草，可活死人，肉白骨；芝王奇应散以灵芝为引，服之亦有除百病、益气力之效。

Desc_280.en: Tiger Warrior is made of tiger bone as the ruling medicinal, combined with various herbs and strong liquor, it has the effect of strengthening the bones and enhancing the strength. It can make people forget themselves and become as powerful as a tiger.
Desc_280.cn: 虎力士乃以虎骨为君药，佐以各种药材并烈酒制成，有壮骨强身，提升力量之效，服后可使人浑然忘我，如有猛虎之威。

Desc_281.en: The Vigor Pill is made with the essence of the beast as the main ingredient, after eating it, you will feel a surge of strength around your body, killing like the tiger and moving like the wind.
Desc_281.cn: 生龙活虎丸以凶兽之精华部位为主材炮制，服之则顿觉周身力气上涌，可如生龙活虎一般，杀入阵去，腾挪如风。

Desc_282.en: The Trio Strength Pill is made of three rare herbs as the catalyst, and its effect of tonic yang is the best in all medicines. Its color is like gold and jade, and it can make people gain the power of moving mountains and seas.
Desc_282.cn: 魁即首也。三魁大力丹以三味珍奇药材为引制成，补阳之效乃药中之魁，其色似金亦似玉，服之只觉“回山转海不作难”。

Desc_283.en: I wrestled with the tiger with bare hands and my heart never wavered in troubled times. The Lion Killer Powder has a crimson color and a smell of blood, it can make people's blood surge and have the power to fight with lion pack with their bare hands.
Desc_283.cn: 诗云：“手接飞猱搏雕虎，侧足焦原未言苦”，三圣搏狮散成色赤红，嗅之有骨血之腥，服后热血翻涌，顿生圣者与群狮搏斗之力。

Desc_284.en: This pill is made from the bones and blood of spiritual beasts, it has a reddish-brown color, a slightly fishy and sweet taste, and a clear fragrance. It can give people a constant source of strength and deter all the beasts, making them bow down and retreat, hence the name 'Beastlord Pill.'
Desc_284.cn: 此丹乃以灵兽骨血为引制成，色褐而赭，味微腥而甘，有清香，服之可令气力源源不断，使百兽莫敌，俯首退避，故名“兽王丹”。

Desc_285.en: The Blood Turtle Pill is made from the blood of a spiritual beast and is red in color, emitting a dazzling red light. It needs to be contained in a gold vessel because it will hurt people if touched. It can empower people with the might of gods, making it easy to pull up mountains and fill the ocean. Thus it's believed to help one break all techniques.
Desc_285.cn: 血龟通天丹以灵兽精血炼制而成，其色赤红，宝光冲霄，触之即伤，需以金器盛装；服之可得鬼神之威能，纵是拔山填海也易如反掌，或曰：“其力可破万法”。

Desc_286.en: Ginseng can restore the pulse and strengthen the body, and cure the long-term illness. Ginseng pills made from it can replenish primordial Qi and make people strong and agile.
Desc_286.cn: 人参可复脉固脱，治久病羸弱。人参壮气丹以人参为引，服之可补元气，使人身体健壮，行动敏捷。

Desc_287.en: It is said that thin Qi makes a person weak, while dense Qi makes a person strong. This decoction can be taken to make a person dense with Qi, and make him strong and healthy, hence the name 'Dense Qi Decoction.'
Desc_287.cn: “人禀气而生，含气而长”，气离则衰，气合则健，此药服之可使人行气顺畅，身手矫健，故名“气合汤”。

Desc_288.en: It is believed that "the clear Qi stays above while the turbid Qi lies below." It is said that the spleen is responsible for raising clarity and the stomach is responsible for lowering turbidness. The disorder between the clarity and turbidness will cause the whole body to fall into chaos. This elixir tastes slightly numb and stings the throat. It enters the two meridians of the spleen and stomach to bring the clarity and turbidness into place and harmonize the whole body.
Desc_288.cn: 所谓：“清气在上，浊气在下”，脾主升清，胃主降浊，清浊相乱，则四体不安。此药味微麻而刺喉，入脾胃二经，服之可令清浊归位，四体轻便。

Desc_289.en: The Jade Spring Tonic is made from a variety of elixirs supplemented with morning dew. It is dark purple in color and has a healthy effect on the body when taken. It shimmers with a fragrant spiritual light, and it is rumored that the view of the immortal Jade Spring can be seen in it.
Desc_289.cn: 灵池香露乃是集山海之灵药，辅以朝露熬制而成，其药色墨紫，服之有健体之效，其上灵光闪烁，香气馥郁，传闻可见仙家瑶池之景。

Desc_290.en: The vast sky does not talk, and the dews cover the pines. The Dark Sky Elixir is as black as ink, thick as mush, and can be taken to calm Yin and Yang and nourish the spirit.
Desc_290.cn: 有道是：“玄天何以言，瑞露青松繁”。玄天宝饮色黑如墨，浓稠如羹，服之可使阴平阳秘，滋养精神。

Desc_291.en: Already soaked in the energy from the Ginseng, it becomes more refreshing from frost and snow. Snow Ginseng Elixir is made from rare snow ginseng and supplemented with snow water. It can invigorate one's spirit as if covered by frost and snow.
Desc_291.cn: 诗云：“已有参仙生元气，更得霜雪澡精神”，参仙雪饮以罕见雪参为引，辅以雪水制成，服后使人如沐霜雪，神气为之一振。

Desc_292.en: The Jasmine Dry Perfume is made from the juice of jasmine, and is a fine white granule with a refreshing scent.
Desc_292.cn: 素馨提神散乃以素馨花汁调制而成，其色素白，颗粒细腻，近闻之似有清香，有醒神之效。

Desc_293.en: The Permeant Incense needs to be lit with a jade vessel. When it is first lit, it is imperceptible, but in a few moments, the fragrance will seep into the body and nourish the meridians, leaving the ancient people wondering, "Who could have invented such a celestial scent?"
Desc_293.cn: 诗云：“谁把幽香透骨薰”，透心香需以玉器盛之点燃，初时不觉，但少顷便有幽香透骨，沁入心脾，滋养人身经脉。

Desc_294.en: The Loong Incense will form a yellow smoke near the ground after being lit, which will not dissipate for a long time, just like a loong hibernating in the water, it can nourish the spirit and benefit the body.
Desc_294.cn: 潜龙香烟色鹅黄，燃起后经久不散，伏于地底，宛如龙在水中，用之可以长精神，益体魄，似得蛟龙潜伏起用之妙。

Desc_295.en: The Six Divines, namely the Emerald Loong, the White Tiger, the Vermilion Bird, the Black Tortoise, the Sky Serpent, and the Earth Loong. The smoke from the Six Divines Incense in a serene chamber will take the form of those divine beasts. Legend has it that this incense can borrow the divine power of the Six Divines to make people move quickly and as fast as clouds.
Desc_295.cn: 六神，即青龙、白虎、朱雀、玄武、腾蛇、勾陈。燃六神元气香于静室，其烟自成神兽之形，传说可请六神协力，使人行动迅速，疾如烟云。

Desc_296.en: Ten kinds of precious herbs are used to refine the Nourishing Ten Pill, which can be taken to gather energy and nourish the spirit, so that people can gain strength, and there are rumors that it can make souls and spirits all return to their places, which is very miraculous.
Desc_296.cn: 十香聚元丹取十数种名贵药材炼制而成，服之可聚元养神，使人意达劲至，更有传闻能令三魂七魄皆归其位，神异非常。

Desc_297.en: The Taoist does not understand drinks but gets drunk as if immersed in heaven. The Drunk Mortal Elixir is the strong liquor soaked with a divine jade, with a light green color and lingering aroma, rumored to be able to keep for hundreds of years. Those who drink it will look like a drunken immortal, swaying when they strike, but never miss.
Desc_297.cn: “道人不解饮，醺然醉天香”，天香醉仙饮以神玉置于美酒之中，其色淡青，香气苍劲，传闻可历百年而不坏，饮之则宛如醉仙临世，出手时恍恍惚惚，却又绝无错漏。

Desc_298.en: The Ruby Honey is made of honey, sweet and delicious, transparent as crystal, red as pomegranate, can be taken to enhance eyesight.
Desc_298.cn: 明红蜜乃以蜂蜜调制而成，甘甜可口，通透如水晶，色赤如石榴，服之可以补中明目。

Desc_299.en: Heart is of fire and is the master of blood. The Refreshing Pill can dispel the evil heat in the body, refresh the mind, and can also be taken in summer to cool off the heat.
Desc_299.cn: 所谓：“心属火，主身之血脉”，清补丸可清心中邪火，提神开窍，亦可于夏日服之，冰凉去热。

Desc_300.en: Humans can think thanks to the wisdom they are gifted with. The Gifted Wisdom Decoction is made by cooking spiritual herbs three times, and it makes people feel refreshed and as if they have been gifted with wisdom after taking it.
Desc_300.cn: “人也者，托於天智以思虑”，天智汤乃以灵草三煎而成，服后可令人精神爽畅，得天赋之智。

Desc_301.en: Anything that comes from the Mt. Ling is beyond the wisdom of the mortal realm. It is said that the Mt. Ling is the residence of Buddha. This medicine is made of immortal flowers and herbs, can clear one's mind as if they are listening to the teachings of Buddha on the Mt. Ling.
Desc_301.cn: “灵山远飞来，不可以智测”，传闻灵山乃佛之居所，可助有情开悟，此药以琪花瑶草制成，服后可使心境澄澈，如至灵山，谛听佛语。

Desc_302.en: The White Frost Pill is made of spiritual objects, white as jade, as if covered with a layer of snow frost. It has an ice-cold taste and can clear one's mind.
Desc_302.cn: 传闻玉能通神，灵感天地；天霜白玉丸以灵物制成，色白如玉，如被霜雪，服之冰凉，使人精神为之爽，心智为之明。

Desc_303.en: The snow lotus absorbing the spiritual Qi of the world grows through a thousand years of frost and can be rolled into a pill, shining with a bright spiritual light, can be taken to nourish the spirit and expand wisdom.
Desc_303.cn: 水润泽四方，得万物灵气。雪莲历千年寒霜而生，入药后皎然如水，抟制成丹，灵光皎洁，服之可养灵根，开慧眼，识世间万妙。

Desc_304.en: This medicine is made of realgar, astragalus and polygonatum, realgar nourishes the liver, astragalus nourishes the lungs and polygonatum nourishes the Qi, so this medicine can keep visceral organs healthy and the mind clear. It is said that this prescription was invented by one of the founders of Taoism, so it is called "Founder Powder."
Desc_304.cn: 此药以雄黄、绵黄、黄精为引，雄黄入肝，绵黄归肺，黄精补气，服之使人心正神明，传闻乃玉清天尊所遗，故称“三黄玉清散”。

Desc_305.en: The Immortal Herb Elixir has a pale green color and the effect of concentration, and its taste is delicious and refreshing. It can make people drift into ecstasy, and every move is like being guided by immortals.
Desc_305.cn: 仙草饮成色苍翠欲滴，有凝神之效，其味清新爽口，服之飘然迷醉，一举一动却又如得仙人指引，合于大道。

Desc_306.en: The Emerald Spring Elixir has the same emerald color and cool taste as a clear spring, which can reconcile the two Qi of Yin and Yang and wash away dust and dirt.
Desc_306.cn: 奇秀碧饮盛色如绿泉，其味清凉，视之若有世间诸般奇景，深杳秀丽，服之可调和阴阳二气，洗濯尘垢。

Desc_307.en: The Seven Luxuries refer to gold, silver, colored glaze, crystal, jade, red pearl and amber. The Seven Luxuries Pill is said to be made from the essence of the Seven Luxuries and Herbs, with a shell like jasper and seven colors of light intermingling inside.
Desc_307.cn: 七宝又称七珍，为黄金、白银、琉璃、颇梨、美玉、赤珠、琥珀。七宝翠玉丸传说由七珍之精华加以药材制成，壳如碧玉，内中有七色华光交相辉映，如见世间诸妙。

Desc_308.en: The Emperor Star, surrounded by all the stars, resides in the northern sky. The color of this pill is like Lazurite, and there is a convergence of immortal energy on it, so you can take it to get the power of the emperor star and look beyond the mundane.
Desc_308.cn: 紫薇即紫微，乃帝星，众星拱绕之，居北极。此丹色如青金，其上有仙气汇聚，服之可得帝星之力，睥睨凡俗。

Desc_309.en: There is a saying: "Loong spittle needs deep ash and gentle heat." The Loong Spittle Pill needs to take loong's spittle with jade, seal the lid and put it in the burning ash of Parasol wood for a long time before it takes the shape of a pill, which can make people fly like a loong.
Desc_309.cn: 有道是：“深灰慢火养龙涎”。龙涎无极丹需以温玉盛取龙涎，封盖置于梧桐木燃灰中，许久方成丹形，服之可翩若游龙，妙化无极。

Desc_310.en: Dybowski's Frog Paste is made by boiling the essence of Dybowski's Frog, its color is milky white, its taste is fresh and fragrant, taking it can tonify the kidneys and relieve fatigue.
Desc_310.cn: 雪蛤膏乃取雪蛤精华熬制而成，其色乳白，其味鲜香，服之可补肾益精，消疲解乏。

Desc_311.en: Immortal Crane Powder is made of medicine to invigorate the blood and relax the tendons, and it can make people light and healthy, so they can "stand on the pine tree at the top of the mountain" like a crane.
Desc_311.cn: 仙鹤散以活血舒筋之药制成，服后身轻体健，便可如仙鹤一般“云松栖稳枝”，“落落欲往，矫矫不群”。

Desc_312.en: The essence of body tempering is the Qi. The Steadiness Pill is orange in color and has a faint sweet taste, can strengthen the body and make one's pace steady, and is commonly used by people who practice martial arts.
Desc_312.cn: 俗谓：“炼体之道，贵在真元”，固真丸成色橘黄，味甘而平，服之可以固元健本，使人步伐平稳，习武之人常用之。

Desc_313.en: The Herb-mix Pill is made from a hundred kinds of herbs refined through seven processes, and the color has changed seven times. It can nourish the innate essence, benefit the energy, and strengthen the muscles, bones, the liver and kidneys.
Desc_313.cn: 百草七结丹乃取百草，经七道工序炼制而成，其色七变，服之可补元精、益中气、强筋骨、健肝肾。

Desc_314.en: The Spirit is the vigor and the Treasure is the essence. The Spirit Strider Decoction was originally formulated for the Taoists, and can be taken to calm the mind, fix the essence and make people walk as fast as flying.
Desc_314.cn: “行益易者，谓常思灵宝。灵者，神也；宝者，精也”。灵宝金汤本为道者研制，服之可以安神固精，使人步履矫健。

Desc_315.en: It is believed that "when one has attained the Tao, they will keep their childlike appearance and black hair forever." It has tuber fleeceflower's spiritual Qi and contains black divine light, can fix teeth and blacken hair, and temporarily rejuvenate.
Desc_315.cn: 世说：“得道者童颜鹤发，食首乌者童颜黑发”。此药含首乌灵气，蕴墨色神光，服之可固齿乌发，暂还青春。

Desc_316.en: The mountains are covered in dark canopies, and tigers roam the forest the entire day. The Killer Tiger Powder is a strong and fierce medicine that can be taken to make the person stable and healthy, with the aura of a killer tiger.
Desc_316.cn: “南山北山树冥冥，猛虎白日绕林行”，虎为百姓之患。伏虎散药性刚猛，服之可使人身稳气健，如有虎贲之势。

Desc_317.en: This decoction can nourish the vital energy, and it is said that it can make the former tournament champion run a full circle around the capital without feeling tired, so it is called 'Champion Decoction.'
Desc_317.cn: 武周长安二年，帝设武举，世人始得以武见进；至赵宋裕陵时，方有“武状元”之名。此汤补元益中，传闻可令昔时武状元日巡京城而气息不滞，故称“武状元汤”。

Desc_318.en: This decoction has the effect of strengthening the body and nourishing the primordial Qi, with a slightly red color and a strong aroma, and it is warm all over the body when drunk, enabling people to lie on ice in the coldest winter without freezing.
Desc_318.cn: 此汤有强身健体、大补元气之效，其色微红，香气浓厚，饮之则遍体温热，便是于数九严寒之中卧于冰上亦不为惧。

Desc_319.en: The Nine-exotic Decoction is made of nine kinds of exotic herbs, its color is crimson, crystal clear and bright, and there are fine filaments in between, which can emit bright light "that shoots directly between the Ox and the Dipper." It can make people run like a fierce tiger.
Desc_319.cn: 天宝九物汤以九种奇珍制成，其色血红，晶莹透亮，间中宛有细丝，观之有“物华天宝，龙光射牛斗之墟”之相，乃是金水相生之药，服之可如龙飞虎奔。

Desc_320.en: It is said that the Immortal Jade Liquor is brewed by Alchemists in the heavenly palace, it is as crystal clear as jade and can be taken to relieve sorrows and ascend to immortality.
Desc_320.cn: “道人读丹经，方士炼玉液”，“旨酒盈金觞，清颜发朱华”。传闻金觞玉液乃天宫仙酿，灵光如玉，服之可生仙骨，可解千愁。

Desc_321.en: What a graceful lady in her early years like a cardamom flower in early February. The Adolescent Pill has the aroma of ginger and cinnamon and tastes like milk. It can make a person temporarily free from mortality, fast and healthy, like an adolescent, making it a rare and wondrous medicine.
Desc_321.cn: 有道是：“娉娉袅袅十三余，豆蔻梢头二月初”。豆蔻不老丹香如姜桂，味甘近乳，服后可使人暂脱凡胎，体轻身健，如归豆蔻之年，乃不可多得之奇药。

Desc_322.en: White cloths for robes and red carriages for guests. Red carriages are commonly used by rich families, painted with vermilion lacquer, smooth and light. This medicine can make people move smoothly and swiftly like a red carriage, so it is called "Red Carriage Powder."
Desc_322.cn: 诗云：“裁衫催白纻，迎客走朱车”，朱车乃富家常用之物，外涂朱漆，平稳轻便，此药服后可使人动如朱车之疾，故名“朱车散”。

Desc_323.en: The Sunset Pill has the same color as the sunset and a salty-sweet taste, and is made of a variety of herbs that nourish the Qi and invigorate the blood. It can make one's Qi and blood flow smoothly and move like flowing clouds.
Desc_323.cn: 抱霞丹色如虹霞，味甘而咸，乃以多种养气活血之药制成，服后可使人气血和顺，行动处宛如行云流水。

Desc_324.en: The Flight Elixir is clear, sweet and transparent, and it makes you feel light and healthy as if you are "a cloud flying above the heaven.."
Desc_324.cn: 飞来饮清冽甘香，澄净通透，饮之可令五体轻健，举步生风，可谓：“飞云飘无影，疑从天外来”。

Desc_325.en: It is made of immortal grass, immortal thatch and immortal dew, hence the name 'Three-immortal Powder.' It has the effect of tonifying the Qi, and lightening and strengthening the body.
Desc_325.cn: 此散以仙草、仙茅、仙露制成，有理气通顺、轻身健体之效，服之则行动迅捷，若逐光而行，故名“三仙逐光散”。

Desc_326.en: As the clouds rose and the moon first came out last night, the nectar that had been nourished for thousands of years adorned the sky. The Five-color Nectar is made from the dew at the time of the alternation of the sun and moon plus the juice of immortal grasses, and is capable of emitting a brilliant five-color light.
Desc_326.cn: 诗云：“昨夜云生拜初月，万年甘露水晶盘”。五色华光露乃采日月交替之时的露水加仙草汁液制成，其色五彩，光华绚烂。

Desc_327.en: Brewed from Afterlife Flowers, it is said to be a serendipitous discovery of Du Kang, the Chinese liquor originator. Those who drink it are said to feel as if gifted with the wings of a mystical bird, their bodies light as a feather, drifting into a state of ethereal bliss.
Desc_327.cn: 荼冥仙露以荼冥花酿成，传闻乃杜康制酒时偶然所得，服之则如得玄鸟之翼，身轻如羽，飘然欲仙。

Desc_328.en: The Wind-proof Pill is made of magnetic stone, it's dark green with a faintly transparent light. It enables people to resist the wind, immobile while standing against the wind, loved by sailors.
Desc_328.cn: 定风丹以慈石为引，色如碧潭，隐有幽光，服后可导气回风，于逆风之中亦可巍然屹立，素为海客所爱。

Desc_329.en: It is commonly said that ordinary people do not know the truth from falsehood, like a monkey trying to get the moon in water. The Moon in Water is made from the material that can dredge the veins, and can be taken to clear the eyes and mind, so that the true and false are not confused.
Desc_329.cn: 俗谓世人不识真伪，如猕猴欲得水中之月，水月空青丸以通脉之物制成，服之可明目去翳，使真假不迷，心念澄净。

Desc_330.en: This pill is made of herb garden soil, stone in the soil, tree by the river, grass under the tree and dew on the grass. It emits seven colors of precious light, so it is called 'Seven-color Pill.' It can harmonize blood and Qi, and remove turbidity to obtain clarity.
Desc_330.cn: 此丸取药园土、土中石、河畔树、树下草、草上露炮制而成，五行皆备，相生相依，成药有七色宝光，故名“七色宝丸”，服之可令气血和顺，去浊取清。

Desc_331.en: Legend has it that the resplendent light of the rainbow is ever-changing and only immortals can use it. This medicine is as clear as water and can make people move quickly after taking it, and the viewer can only see "the resplendent light of the rainbow among the clouds," so it is called "Resplendent Nectar."
Desc_331.cn: 传说虹霓之光瞬息万变，唯仙人可用之，此药清澈如水，服后行动迅疾，观者只见虹霓清光，正是“青云衣兮白霓裳，举长矢兮射天狼”，故名“霓裳清露”。

Desc_332.en: Thunders do not disturb his ears, and mountains and valleys do not slow down his steps. The Divine Strider Pill is made of the most spiritual substance on earth, which can raise the clearness and remove the turbidity, enabling people to travel a thousand miles a day like a divine horse.
Desc_332.cn: 所谓：“雷霆不乱其听，山谷不踬其步，神行而已”，千里神行丹以人间至灵之物制成，可扬清去浊，服之矫然如天马，有日行千里之势。

Desc_333.en: Rumor has it that the cicada will lie dormant underground for a hundred years, only once every ten years to shed its shell and become an immortal cicada after nine sheddings. This pill is made of Ignefrost Cicada, containing the spiritual Qi of heaven and earth, the light of the sun and moon. It can make the body lighter and faster, as if feathered and immortal.
Desc_333.cn: 传闻寒蝉蛰地百年，其壳十载一蜕，共九蜕则可成仙蝉。此丹以炽羽寒蝉制成，蕴天地灵气，日月之光，服之可身轻体捷，恍如羽化而登仙。

Desc_334.en: The Green Evil Pill is made by pounding the grass that wards off evil into juice, and removing its toxicity with the 'poison counter poison' method. This pill is green in color, uses the spirit of the grass to guide the evil Qi, and can make people shiver with fear at a glance.
Desc_334.cn: 取辟邪之草捣成汁液，再用“以毒攻毒”之法去除毒性，方得绿戾丸。此丸颜色乌青，以草之灵性导邪戾之气，望之胆寒。

Desc_335.en: The Disturbing Powder is made of aromatic grasses, emitting a long-lasting fragrance, the body will emit a strange aroma a few moments after taking it. Although the user does not notice it, it can disturb the mind of others.
Desc_335.cn: 盛熏散以香草制成，其气芬芳，经久不散，服后片刻便令体生异香，随风而动，己虽不觉，却可扰人心神，乱人行动。

Desc_336.en: The marshal is the backbone of the army, but he also carries the sin of killing. This decoction is extremely rigid and fierce, it can make a person's aura rise steeply. If drank by a marshal, then he will definitely fight to the death.
Desc_336.cn: 正所谓：“一将功成万骨枯”，将军乃定国之柱，却也背负杀戮之孽，此汤性极刚猛，服后可使人气势陡升，若沙场名将，刀必见血、有去无回。

Desc_337.en: The Yaksha is the guardian deity in Buddhism, fierce and swift. This is called 'Yaksha Powder' because it can stimulate people's courage and make them as strong and invincible as the Yaksha that protects the Dharma.
Desc_337.cn: 夜叉乃天龙八部众之一，迅捷有力，曾为菩萨化形。此散可激发人之勇猛，使之矫健如护法夜叉，所向披靡，故名“夜叉散”。

Desc_338.en: After taking this medicine, people will make the expression of the Acala when he is angry, which can make demons fearful and outlaws scared. And people will know Bodhicitta when seeing him, and renounce evil when hearing his name.
Desc_338.cn: 此药服后则有忿怒之相，如不动明王发“见我身者发菩提心，闻我名者断恶修善”，破除众生迷障之愿，可令邪魔惊惧，外道胆寒。

Desc_339.en: Loongs have incredible power, but occasionally there are evil loongs that are difficult for mortals to match to harm the world. This pill is pale in color and can be taken to strengthen the body and get the divine power to subdue the evil loong.
Desc_339.cn: 龙居八部第二，其力不可思议，偶有恶者为害世间，凡人难以匹敌。此丹颜色苍白，服之可淬炼肉身，如得罗汉降龙之威能。

Desc_340.en: This paste is made from the ghost insects that drink the blood of the beast king, it can make people have the same aura as the beast king. Its color is black, seems to have a ghostly face on it, and its weirdness and horror can stop children from crying at night.
Desc_340.cn: 鬼虫饮兽王精血而生，以之炮制为膏，则服者如有百兽臣服之势；其色乌黑，似有鬼面生于其上，怪异可怖，能止小儿夜哭。

Desc_341.en: The Bloodrage Pill is refined with the blood of spiritual beasts. It has a black-red color and a fiery taste. After taking it, one's meridians seem to be burning, the eyes are red and itchy, and it is like losing one's wits against the enemy, and every move is a killing blow.
Desc_341.cn: 血炼丹需以灵兽之血炼制，色赭而黑，其味酷辣，服后如有烈火灼烧经脉，使人双目赤红，痛痒难忍，对敌时如丧神智，招招夺命。

Desc_342.en: The Stench Mania Powder is made from the Zang-fu organs of five kinds of spiritual creatures, so there is a strong stench. After taking it, one will feel the pain of being tortured and it causes illusions and near madness. After the strength of the medicine wears off, one can gain the divine power to move mountains and seas.
Desc_342.cn: 奇腥五狂散共取五种灵物之腑脏制成，其腥无比，服之如受炮烙之刑、分尸之酷，幻影如真，纷乱欲狂，药劲化散四体之后，则怒发冲冠，似可移山填海。

Desc_343.en: In the extremities of all directions lie the barren lands. This golden-red powder, when taken, can invigorate people's spirit and make them brave enough to conquer other countries, so it is called "Conqueror's Powder."
Desc_343.cn: “八荒，八方荒忽极远之地也”。此散色赤近金，服后精神振奋，药力无所不至，勇武四土臣服，如有始皇帝“囊括四海，并吞八荒”之意，故称“八荒散”。

Desc_344.en: Black Frenzy Powder is made from strange beasts, its taste is extremely bitter. After taking it, a person will become like a demon with black eyes, and even ordinary moves will come with great strength, and if not for the fact that the medicine only lasts for a while, even the gods can hardly stop it.
Desc_344.cn: 传闻世人心智迷失、为怒所驱时，血色皆化为黑。黑血疯魔散乃以异兽炮制而成，其味极苦，服后状如疯魔，目似深潭，便是寻常招式亦有惊人伟力，若非药力自行消散，神鬼亦难阻挡。

Desc_345.en: According to legend, the Prime Loong is the head of all the loongs, born at the beginning of the earth, has infinite divine power. After living for thousands of years, it disappeared and no one knows where it went. This pill has a trace of the spiritual Qi of the Prime Loong, which can make people gain enough divine power to split the sky.
Desc_345.cn: 相传元龙乃诸龙之首，生于天地冥冥、洪荒初开之时，力可通神，数观沧桑，后不知所踪，此丹留有元龙一丝灵气，服之如获开天之威。

Desc_346.en: Joy and misery are but a cycle; where shall your heart go?
Desc_346.ru: Радость и страдание - всего лишь круговорот; куда направится твое сердце?

Desc_347.en: Inflicted with a Blood-eyed Gu Larva that is attuned to its host.\nThe Blood-eyed Gu is nurtured in a corpse's skull with its body mottled with red spots.
Desc_347.cn: 体内被种下已识主的赤目蛊的若蛊。\n赤目蛊双瞳血红，身有赤斑，乃是于死人头颅当中炼制而成的苗疆蛊虫。

Desc_367.en: Inflicted with a Tenebrous Gu Larva that is attuned to its host.\nThe Tenebrous Gu can only hatch from corpses found in areas imbued with pure Yin Qi. Once burrowed into the body of a living creature, it grows rapidly by devouring the host's flesh from within.
Desc_367.cn: 体内被种下已识主的尸螭蛊的若蛊。\n以死于至阴之地，命格纯阴的死尸炼养蛊虫，遂成“九阴尸螭蛊”。九阴尸螭蛊一入活人体内便即疯长，饱食血肉后便破体而出，状若大螭。

Capable of spinning icy-cold silk, this parasite fills its victim's veins with chilly toxins, freezing them to death in an instant. Even the dead body won't decompose, as if kept in cold storage.
Desc_372.cn: 体内被种下已识主的冰蚕蛊的若蛊。\n碧玉冰蚕蛊通体碧绿，行走如风，奇毒至寒，能吐冰丝，冰丝一旦侵入血脉，中者立刻僵毙，死后尸体不腐。

Desc_382.cn: 体内被种下已识主的青髓蛊的若蛊。\n百彩青髓蛊以万蛊炼育而成，其色无名，其体无形，可飞天遁地，如鬼似魅，此蛊极通灵性，能懂人言。

Desc_387.en: A most legendary pill that eliminates one's spirit and thereby frees their body. They will not die at the end of the lifespan, but at the end of the pill's effect.
Desc_387.cn: 灭除精神而使肉身不受寿元限制的奇药，在药力耗尽前，服食者不会因寿元耗尽而死……

Desc_388.en: Liao Wuming from Kongsang understands that he will never attain the formula of immortality, so he turns his back on the great ambitions of his family and concocts this ultimate poison of this world. According to himself, those who are infected are but walking dead.
Desc_388.cn: 空桑廖无命因深感研制长生之药无望，故而放弃祖宗宏愿，潜心研制的天下第一奇毒，据其自述，称中者必死，流毒无穷……

Desc_404.en: If the character has <color=#hotpoison>Acritoxin</color>, <color=#redpoison>Pyrotoxin</color>, and <color=#rottenpoison>Necrotoxin</color> Markers when months change, <color=#brightred>they'll lose a great amount of [Health]</color> based on the number of those Markers.
Desc_404.cn: 在月份更替时，如果人物同时身中<color=#hotpoison>烈毒</color>、<color=#redpoison>赤毒</color>、<color=#rottenpoison>腐毒</color>标记， <color=#brightred>大幅减少人物的「健康」</color>，减少程度受上述标记数量影响。

Desc_405.en: If the character has <color=#hotpoison>Acritoxin</color>, <color=#rottenpoison>Necrotoxin</color>, and <color=#illusorypoison>Oneirotoxin</color> Markers, <color=#brightred>they will gain the debuff [Reduced Nimble Practice Slots]</color> based on the number of those Markers, until the mixed poisons are purged.
Desc_405.cn: 如果人物同时身中<color=#hotpoison>烈毒</color>、<color=#rottenpoison>腐毒</color>、<color=#illusorypoison>幻毒</color>标记，<color=#brightred>获得「轻灵运功栏位减少」的减益</color>，直到驱除此混合毒素，减少程度受上述标记数量影响。

Desc_406.en: If the character has <color=#hotpoison>Acritoxin</color>, <color=#gloomypoison>Umbritoxin</color>, and <color=#rottenpoison>Necrotoxin</color> Markers when months change, <color=#brightred>they'll be in great agony and discard several of their items</color>, the quantity of which is affected by the number of those Markers.
Desc_406.cn: 在月份更替时，如果人物同时身中<color=#hotpoison>烈毒</color>、<color=#gloomypoison>郁毒</color>、<color=#rottenpoison>腐毒</color>标记， <color=#brightred>人物会痛苦难熬，将数个自己的物品丢弃</color>，丢弃数量受上述标记数量影响。

Desc_407.en: If the character has <color=#hotpoison>Acritoxin</color>, <color=#coldpoison>Cryotoxin</color>, and <color=#rottenpoison>Necrotoxin</color> Markers, <color=#brightred>they will gain the debuff [Increased <color=#redpoison>Pyrotoxin</color>]</color> based on the number of those Markers, until the mixed poisons are purged.
Desc_407.cn: 如果人物同时身中<color=#hotpoison>烈毒</color>、<color=#coldpoison>寒毒</color>、<color=#rottenpoison>腐毒</color>标记， <color=#brightred>获得「<color=#redpoison>赤毒</color>获取量提升」的减益</color>，直到驱除此混合毒素，提升量受上述标记数量影响。

Desc_410.en: If the character has <color=#redpoison>Pyrotoxin</color>, <color=#coldpoison>Cryotoxin</color>, and <color=#rottenpoison>Necrotoxin</color> Markers when months change, <color=#brightred>your character will spread their <color=#rottenpoison>Necrotoxin</color> to other characters in the same tile</color>. The amount of the spread is affected by the number of those Markers.
Desc_410.cn: 在月份更替时，如果人物同时身中<color=#redpoison>赤毒</color>、<color=#coldpoison>寒毒</color>、<color=#rottenpoison>腐毒</color>标记， <color=#brightred>人物会将所中<color=#rottenpoison>腐毒</color>扩散给同地格的人物</color>，扩散的毒素量受上述标记数量影响。

Desc_412.en: If the character has <color=#hotpoison>Acritoxin</color>, <color=#gloomypoison>Umbritoxin</color>, and <color=#redpoison>Pyrotoxin</color> Markers when months change, <color=#brightred>their face will be destroyed by poison</color> based on the number of those Markers and return to normal when the poison is dispelled.
Desc_412.cn: 在月份更替时，如果人物同时身中<color=#hotpoison>烈毒</color>、<color=#gloomypoison>郁毒</color>、<color=#redpoison>赤毒</color>标记， <color=#brightred>人物的容貌会为恶毒摧残</color>，直到连续三月未受到此效果影响时才会恢复，容貌摧残的程度受上述标记数量影响。

Desc_424.en: The Bloody-eyed Gu is nurtured in a corpse's skull with its body mottled with red spots.\nBorn in the Myriad Gu Jar, tempered by countless poisons, the Prime Blood-eyed Gu is deadlier than any of its kind.
Desc_424.cn: 赤目蛊双瞳血红，身有赤斑，乃是于死人头颅当中炼制而成的苗疆蛊虫。\n赤目王蛊更是于万蛊坛中浴万毒而生，毒性远胜寻常。

Desc_425.en: The Illusionary Gu is a faintly glowing parasite of a lilac hue, feeding on various flowers and smoked with dozens of types of fragrant wood.\nBorn in the Myriad Gu Jar, tempered by countless poisons, the Prime Illusionary Gu is deadlier than any of its kind.
Desc_425.cn: 螭魅蛊经过百花喂养，再以数十种香木熏染，体色淡紫，微微有光。\n魑魅王蛊更是于万蛊坛中浴万毒而生，毒性远胜寻常。

Desc_426.en: The Corruptive Gu is a breed of jet-black parasite reeking of foul stench and enters human body through bone-baring flesh wounds.\nBorn in the Myriad Gu Jar, tempered by countless poisons, the Prime Corruptive Gu is deadlier than any of its kind.
Desc_426.cn: 黑血蛊通体乌黑，奇腥奇臭，乃是穿透敌人血肉，再施于敌人骨骼之上的毒蛊。\n黑血王蛊更是于万蛊坛中浴万毒而生，毒性远胜寻常。

Desc_427.en: The Delirious Gu is a secret breed used in the Five Immortals Sect' lynch for traitors. As it's hard to come by, nothing of its form is known.\nBorn in the Myriad Gu Jar, tempered by countless poisons, the Prime Delirious Gu is deadlier than any of its kind.
Desc_427.cn: 心魔蛊乃是五仙教用于惩罚叛徒的秘虫，极难炼制，形态亦鲜为人知。\n心魔王蛊更是于万蛊坛中浴万毒而生，毒性远胜寻常。

Desc_428.en: The Tenebrous Gu can only hatch from corpses found in areas imbued with pure Yin energy. Once burrowed into the body of a living creature, the Tenebrous Gu Infection grows rapidly by devouring the host's flesh from within. When it has reached its serpent-like adult stage, it begins to gnaw its way out.\nBorn in the Myriad Gu Jar, tempered by countless poisons, the Prime Tenebrous Gu is deadlier than any of its kind.
Desc_428.cn: 以死于至阴之地，命格纯阴的死尸炼养蛊虫，遂成“九阴尸螭蛊”。九阴尸螭蛊一入活人体内便即疯长，饱食血肉后便破体而出，状若大螭。\n尸螭王蛊更是于万蛊坛中浴万毒而生，毒性远胜寻常。

Desc_429.en: The Gelid Gu is extremely nimble with a beryl body. Capable of spinning icy-cold silk, this parasite fills its victim's veins with chilly toxins, freezing them to death in an instant. Even the dead body won't decompose, as if kept in cold storage.\nBorn in the Myriad Gu Jar, tempered by countless poisons, the Prime Gelid Gu is deadlier than any of its kind.
Desc_429.cn: 碧玉冰蚕蛊通体碧绿，行走如风，奇毒至寒，能吐冰丝，冰丝一旦侵入血脉，中者立刻僵毙，死后尸体不腐。\n冰蚕王蛊更是于万蛊坛中浴万毒而生，毒性远胜寻常。

Desc_430.en: Appearing like a big golden silkworm, the Aureate Gu is exalted as the King of Gu for its deleterious virulence and extraordinary capability of inflicting agony.\nBorn in the Myriad Gu Jar, tempered by countless poisons, the Prime Aureate Gu is deadlier than any of its kind.
Desc_430.cn: 金蚕乃蛊中王虫，有如金色大蚕，万中无一。金蚕蛊毒猛如烈火，中者惨不堪言，痛不欲生。\n金蚕王蛊更是于万蛊坛中浴万毒而生，毒性远胜寻常。

Desc_431.en: The sole survivor of 10,000 venomous Gu devouring one another becomes the Prismatic Gu. With an indescribable appearance and an unpredictable behavior, this almost sentient parasite can even understand human language.\nBorn in the Myriad Gu Jar, tempered by countless poisons, the Prime Prismatic Gu is deadlier than any of its kind.
Desc_431.cn: 百彩青髓蛊以万蛊炼育而成，其色无名，其体无形，可飞天遁地，如鬼似魅，此蛊极通灵性，能懂人言。\n青髓王蛊更是于万蛊坛中浴万毒而生，毒性远胜寻常。

Desc_432.en: The Celestial Rune is an embodiment of mortal thoughts, its substance like mist or cloud. Its front side is blank, yet when touched, one can faintly hear the obsessions held in human hearts. On its back is inscribed cloud seal script, profound and obscure—only those who have attained the enlightenment can decipher its meaning: consuming it grants the power to transform one's body and spirit, granting the power to cross tribulations and ascend to immortality.
Desc_432.cn: 天劫符箓乃是人间诸念聚集而成，质地如云似雾，其正面空白无字，伸手触及之时，竟能隐隐听闻世人心中所执；背面书有云篆，玄妙奥涩，唯有得道之人方解其意：食如金丹一粒，脱胎换骨，权可踏雷渡劫，早登紫府。
